channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que estará com Flávio Bolsonaro e lamenta possíveis ausências em debates presidenciais: 'Gostaria de vê-los'
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas confirmed his support for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 presidential race, emphasizing that his administration operates with pragmatism regardless of party affiliation. He expressed a desire to see both Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro participate in presidential debates, stating that it helps voters engage with the candidates. The governor advocates for a distinct political alternative and seeks alliances with municipalities across various parties.

item.title: Lula vê Trump como 'aliado improvável' em embate do Brasil contra Marco Rubio, diz Financial Times
item.description: Lula seeks alliance with Trump to counter Marco Rubio in struggle for influence over Brazil, according to Financial Times. Bilateral ties sour amid mutual accusations, as Lula navigates foreign policy amid domestic elections. The strategy aims to counter Rubio's support for conservative candidate Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Centrão evita Flávio para recuperar espaço, diz especialista
item.description: The Centrão avoids supporting Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round to recover space lost to Bolsonaro-aligned candidates in recent elections. Center parties view the 2026 election as an opportunity to counter the advance of Bolsonarismo-linked figures, especially in the Chamber of Deputies, where high parliamentary turnover favored these candidates.

item.title: Uma lição de Mendonça a Moraes e Dino
item.description: André Mendonça gave his first long exclusive interview as a Supreme Federal Court minister to a podcast from his own institute, nearly five years after taking office. The minister, appointed by Jair Bolsonaro, shared his views on judicial and political issues, offering a lesson to other ministers like Moraes and Dino.

item.title: Lula ampliou espaço do Centrão para isolar Flávio em 2026
item.description: Lula expanded ministerial positions to include Centrão parties, trading cargos and emendas to keep them neutral toward Flávio in 2026. This strategy weakened Flávio's access to state media and campaign resources. The move focused on securing congressional majority while preventing a unified opposition bloc.

item.title: Mensagem de lobista liga Lulinha a reunião de governador no Planalto
item.description: The Federal Police found messages on lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger's phone linking Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, to a meeting with the governor of Maranhão, Carlos Brandão, held at the Planalto Palace. According to the lobbyist, Lulinha allegedly promised to approve a construction project in the state during the meeting. The findings were reported by Estadão and O Antagonista.

item.title: Com maior fatia do fundo, PL tem rombo de R$ 80 milhões em verba para campanhas
item.description: The PL faces an R$80 million deficit in campaign funding distribution for 2026, despite being the largest recipient of the electoral fund. Money management is led by Valdemar Costa Neto, who already spent R$120 million in pre-campaign activities. The party's presidential ticket is headed by Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Durigan usa imprecisões ao defender política fiscal de Lula
item.description: Finance Minister Dário Durigan defends Lula's fiscal policy using imprecise claims, omitting Central Bank criticism and failing to compare public debt with the previous administration. He blames inflation on the Middle East war and interest rates, ignoring the impact of excessive spending.

item.title: Justiça da Bolívia decreta a prisão preventiva de Fernando Cerimedo, aliado do clã Bolsonaro
item.description: Bolivian justice has ordered the preventive arrest of Fernando Cerimedo, an advisor to Bolivian President Rodrigo Paz, on suspicion of being the mastermind behind a shooting attack against his former partner, lawyer Nadia Beller. Cerimedo, a 45-year-old Argentine, is known for spreading disinformation about Brazilian elections and for having coordinated Javier Milei's digital campaign strategy in Argentina.

item.title: Lulinha 'conseguiu agenda' para governador do MA no Planalto, diz jornal
item.description: Messages found by the Federal Police on lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger's phone suggest Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, mediated a meeting between Maranhão Governor Carlos Brandão and the Planalto Palace. The information was released by Estadão, raising concerns about political influence in federal government agendas.

item.title: EUA procuram governo Lula para retomar negociação sobre tarifaço
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump indicated to Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva the resumption of talks regarding tariffs imposed on Brazilian products, following a phone call between the two leaders last Friday (August 21, 2026). The Ministry of Development, Industry, Trade and Services received contact from Jamieson Greer, the U.S. Trade Representative representative, and a technical meeting is scheduled for next week. The negotiations had been stalled since July, after the U.S. officially introduced new tariffs on Brazilian goods, and Lula emphasized that the justifications for the surcharges are unfounded and harmful to both countries.

item.title: Fluminense x Remo no Brasileirão: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Fluminense and Remo face off on Saturday at 4 PM at Maracanã in the 24th round of the Brazilian Championship. Fluminense, fourth with 38 points, aims to build on their recent form under interim coach Marcão, while Remo fights against relegation. The match will be broadcast exclusively on Premiere.

item.title: PT publica foto de ato em BH e provoca Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The PT posted a photo from the Belo Horizonte rally and taunted Flávio Bolsonaro, while Lula urged votes for the allied ticket and criticized US tariffs. Flávio was also in Minas with government proposals and attacks on the PT.

item.title: Veja a agenda dos candidatos à Presidência neste fim de semana
item.description: Presidential candidates hold campaign activities over the weekend, including debates, events, and launches. The first 2026 presidential debate will take place on Sunday broadcast by Grupo Bandeirantes.

item.title: Datafolha: Flávio lidera entre eleitores do Sul e evangélicos, enquanto Lula tem vantagem entre mulheres, pobres e pretos
item.description: Datafolha poll shows Lula at 47% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 43% for a potential runoff, within margin of error. Lula leads among women, blacks, Catholics and low-income voters, while Flávio leads among evangelicals, Southerners and middle-class voters.

item.title: Datafolha confirma tracking e derruba tese de Flávio, dizem petistas
item.description: The Datafolha poll confirmed Lula's internal tracking numbers, keeping the PT ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro by 4 points in a hypothetical runoff. The campaign interpreted the result as a refutation of claims that the race was tied. Crises involving Lula's relatives and former aides have not impacted voting intentions so far.

item.title: Letícia Barros na Crusoé: O Leviatã eleitoral
item.description: The 2026 electoral campaign will feature a stricter TSE, empowered to suspend content deemed AI-manipulated, with immediate removal and burden of proof on the sender. Letícia Barros is highlighted as a key figure in the discussion on electoral control versus freedom of expression. The article raises concerns about the tribunal’s discretionary power over political information.

item.title: Datafolha expõe a fraqueza da ‘3ª via’ antes de debate esvaziado na ‘Band’
item.description: Datafolha polling confirms Lula's lead (39%) over Flávio Bolsonaro (33%), while third-way candidates show low support. Without the two leading figures, the Band TV debate will feature only four pre-candidates. The weakness of the third way is highlighted by the low voting intentions among other contenders.

item.title: As conexões entre o Sítio de Atibaia e o novo escândalo envolvendo Lulinha
item.description: A new investigation links businessman Fernando Bittar, owner of the Atibaia site used by Lula, to the group of Fábio Luís da Silva (Lulinha) and lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, involved in the INSS scandal. The property, renovated by convicted contractors, was previously used to criminalize the PT leader. Simultaneously, the rental of Lulinha's house in Brasília would have been made in third-party names, with confidentiality clauses, deepening suspicions about public fund embezzlement.

item.title: Gabriela Duarte tenta impedir que a mãe, Regina Duarte, fale sobre política: 'Para de querer responder'
item.description: During an interview with Folha, Regina Duarte was asked about her role in the Bolsonaro government, but her daughter Gabriela tried to avoid the topic. Regina stated she left the government after 74 days without any cost and declined a new public role. Despite her daughter's interference, the actress revisited political comments, creating tension.

item.title: Flávio provoca Lula sobre yanomamis: “Já pode chamar de genocida?”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro provoked Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva with a post on X questioning whether the federal government can be considered genocidal over deaths in Yanomami Territory. The Veja article cited by Bolsonaro reports 1,121 deaths between 2023 and 2025, exceeding the Bolsonaro period. The federal government disputed the data, highlighting improvements in healthcare since 2023.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula vence Flávio entre mulheres, católicos e eleitores mais pobres
item.description: A 2026 Datafolha poll shows Lula leading Flávio Bolsonaro 47% to 43% in a hypothetical second round, with strong support among women, Catholics, and lower-income voters. However, Flávio leads among men, evangelicals, and in Southern and Southeastern regions. The survey interviewed 2,058 voters from August 18-20, with a ±2% margin of error.

item.title: Flávio apela para o vitimismo e diz que aliados o deixaram sozinho
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL presidential candidate, expressed victimization on Jornal do Noblat, complaining about political isolation and accusing former center-right allies of ingratitude for not supporting his campaign. Journalists highlighted the fragility of his candidacy, marked by dependence on Jair Bolsonaro's figure and attempts to appropriate social causes, such as maintaining Bolsa Família, to gain support. The isolation worsened due to uncertainty about his participation in the first TV debate on Band, conditionally supported by Lula's presence.

item.title: Marca do Lula 4 será proteção à família, diz dirigente do PT
item.description: Gutierres Barbosa, religious leader of the PT, claims that Lula's re-election will focus on family protection, highlighting policies such as ending the 6 X 1 scale and university access. The party aims to win back dissatisfied evangelical voters, who show 62% disapproval of Lula in a recent survey. The campaign avoids actions inside churches, prioritizing respect for religions.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro enfrentam alta rejeição e escândalos em largada sob tensão
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro kick off the 2026 presidential race amid high rejection rates and scandals, facing a tight contest. Both are rejected by half of voters and must overcome hurdles to present themselves as the 'lesser evil'.

item.title: Grécia: veja quanto custa morar no país que oferece bolsas de estudo a estrangeiros e como funciona a imigração
item.description: This guide outlines the cost of living, visa options and academic opportunities in Greece forBrazilian nationals considering relocation. With a Mediterranean climate, low crime rates and scholarships from the IKY Foundation, Greeceoffers affordable European living, though the public health system requires attention. Rent prices in Athens range from R$3,000 to R$7,000 per month.

item.title: Lobista bancou viagens de Lulinha para a África e para a Europa
item.description: Businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Lulinha, son of President Lula, arranged and paid for luxury trips to Africa and Paris, according to a Federal Police investigation. Messages suggest Lulinha received financial favors from the entrepreneur, reinforcing suspicions of influence peddling.

item.title: Após improvisos, equipe de Flávio elege duas prioridades para campanha
item.description: Following a disorganized start to the pre-campaign, Flávio Bolsonaro's team has defined two priorities: public security and rising cost of living. Sensitive topics like foreign policy will be approached indirectly to avoid damage, while economists have been brought in to draft government plan proposals.

item.title: “Não acho que o bolsonarismo é essa ameaça toda”, diz candidato do PCO
item.description: Rui Costa Pimenta, PCO candidate for President, stated that Bolsonarism does not represent the main threat to the country, arguing that political polarization reflects popular discontent. He also dismissed the return of a third political path but emphasized the need for serious political struggle to guide the outraged population.

item.title: Quem é a Avibras, empresa de defesa que pode ser comprada pelos irmãos Batista
item.description: Brothers Joesley and Wesley Batista, from JBS, are close to acquiring 100% of Avibras, a major Brazilian defense and aerospace company, following its judicial recovery and amid criticism toward the federal government. The acquisition comes months after a R$300 million investment and strengthens Grupo J&F's expansion in the national security sector.

item.title: Adversários desconfiam que Flávio pode credenciar Marçal para debate
item.description: Campaign members suspect Flávio Bolsonaro may credential Pablo Marçal, barred by TSE, to attend the Band debate. Despite the ban, Marçal claims he will be present at the event, either through an injunction or a public demonstration.

item.title: Roberto Reis na Crusoé: O Ronaldinho que pode derrubar Lula
item.description: The article compares Roberto Reis, a candidate from Crusoé, to Ronaldinho Gaúcho, suggesting he could be a figure capable of challenging Lula's dominance. It references Lula's 2006 remarks about his son's business venture as a metaphor for discussing the potential of new leaders in Brazilian politics. The content implies criticism of the PT legacy and political influence concentration.

item.title: Lula diz ter sugerido a Trump reunião com Putin e Xi Jinping
item.description: President Lula claimed he suggested to Trump a meeting with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin at Mar-a-Lago to discuss solutions for international conflicts. The suggestion was made during a recent conversation between the two leaders.

item.title: Aliado de Eduardo Bolsonaro, assessor do presidente da Colômbia tem prisão preventiva decretada por suspeita de atentado contra ex-namorada
item.description: The Bolivian judiciary ordered six months of preventive detention for Argentine Fernando Cerimedo, an advisor to Rodrigo Paz, on suspicion of planning an assassination attempt against his ex-partner, lawyer Nadia Beller. Cerimedo was already detained after attempting to flee the country and is known for advising right-wing campaigns across Latin America, including Brazil, Argentina and Honduras.

item.title: Trem metropolitano e filas: Tarcísio e Haddad repetem promessas de 2022
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Fernando Haddad (PT) are reusing their 2022 proposals for São Paulo governor, focusing on transportation and public services. Their promises include metro improvements and reducing queues.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: veja o que as pesquisas mostram sobre o voto feminino
item.description: Recent polls show that President Lula leads women’s voting intentions by more than ten points over Flávio Bolsonaro. The gap reflects trends in Datafolha, BTG/Nexus, and Quaest surveys.

item.title: Após Datafolha, Lula vai explorar 'Dark Horse', e Flávio, martelar Lulinha
item.description: The Datafolha poll shows Lula at 47% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 43% in a tight second-round race. Both candidates plan to intensify their campaigns to target vulnerable areas of their opponent, maintaining a balanced contest.

item.title: Tarcísio e Haddad vão intensificar campanhas na Grande SP após Datafolha
item.description: Datafolha poll shows Tarcísio de Freitas with 52% valid votes for reelection, within margin of error. Campaigns will intensify vote competition in Greater São Paulo, where Haddad won in 2022.

item.title: Os 60 anos do CasaGrande, o teatro da democracia
item.description: Casa Grande Theater celebrates its 60th anniversary and was honored by Tancredo Neves in 1984 as 'free territory of democracy in Brazil'. This cultural space resisted the dictatorship and hosted democratic movements. Its history reflects the struggle for democracy in the country.

item.title: Pais e filhos
item.description: A survey reveals that 65.2% of readers believe children's mistakes should be charged to parents, reflecting debates on family responsibility and morality. The content also covers recent political analyses, including the wear of public figures and criticism of power concentrated among the super-rich.

item.title: Infra em 1 minuto: Brasil precisa de Margem Equatorial ter protagonismo
item.description: Specialist Pedro Rodrigues emphasized the importance of the Equatorial Margin to maintain Brazil's oil production, criticizing delays in drilling the Morpho well and warning about pre-salt decline. He advocates for new exploratory frontiers and rejects changes to the concession regime that would affect the region's competitiveness.

item.title: Como a disputa sobre os poderes do STF chega aos programas presidenciais
item.description: The battle over the Supreme Court's powers has become a central theme in the 2026 presidential campaigns, with candidates debating limits on individual rulings, changes to the Court's jurisdiction, and new appointment rules. This institutional escalation, intensified under Bolsonaro, has turned the judiciary into an electoral issue. The programs range from defending the status quo to proposing structural reforms.

item.title: Lula e Flávio têm pouco apoio explícito de líderes evangélicos
item.description: Despite the importance of the evangelical electorate, only two religious leaders have publicly declared support so far: Silas Malafaia for Flávio Bolsonaro and Henrique Vieira for Lula. Most high-profile evangelical leaders remain cautious without public endorsements. The Evangelical Front for the Rule of Law has not yet taken a stance.

item.title: Mandato para ministros do STF não é a solução
item.description: The article criticizes the proposal to establish a fixed term for Supreme Court justices, arguing that it is based on a mistaken diagnosis of the court's crisis. According to the author, the real problems of the STF are linked to institutional and internal governance factors, not the length of ministers' tenure. The solution lies in internal reforms and greater responsibility of the justices themselves, not constitutional changes.

item.title: Lobista diz que Lulinha marcou reunião de governador do MA no Planalto e que Lula ia liberar obra
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger claimed in police messages that Fábio Luís Lula da Silva arranged a meeting between Maranhão Governor Carlos Brandão and the president's chief of staff, suggesting the president would authorize release of public works. The investigation indicates lobbying for contracts and business dealings with the governor, with confirmation that the cited meeting took place.

item.title: Debate presidencial: Estadão fará live especial com análises de colunistas e bastidores na Band
item.description: Estadão and Band host a live presidential debate on October 23 at 8 PM, with pre-analysis starting at 6 PM. Invited candidates include Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Caiado, Zema, Renan Santos, and Augusto Cury, though Lula and Flávio may not attend due to disagreements with the guest list.

item.title: Quem é quem na campanha de Haddad, que tenta desbancar Tarcísio e impulsionar Lula em SP
item.description: Fernando Haddad leads a progressive wing of the PT in São Paulo, running for governor focusing on popular economy, public security, and public education to expand Lula's base. His rhetoric criticizes Tarcísio de Freitas, offering a left-wing alternative to the right-leaning governor. The campaign aims to consolidate progressive voting in the state.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro fazem comícios simultâneos no Rio neste sábado e testam adesão do público
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro hold simultaneous rallies in Rio to test voter engagement in one of Brazil's key electoral colleges. The campaign debates the PT Senate slate, facing criticism from the left over its alliance with the PSD. The event highlights political polarization and the struggle for influence in Rio de Janeiro state.

item.title: Da remoção individual à gestão de riscos sistêmicos
item.description: The liability framework for digital platforms in Brazil has shifted from the individual removal-based model established by Article 19 of the Marco Civil da Internet to a systemic risk management approach, reinforced by 2025 STF rulings and 2026 decrees. This new architecture requires platforms to demonstrate knowledge or a duty to know about risk patterns and to adopt proportional, technically feasible, and documented measures. Proper calibration of this shift is essential to avoid emptying the norm or converting it into disguised strict liability.

item.title: Trump diz a Lula que EUA não vão se envolver nas eleições no Brasil
item.description: In a phone call, President Lula discussed the Brazilian elections with Donald Trump. Trump stated that the United States will not interfere in Brazil's elections. Lula emphasized the reliability of Brazil's electoral system and the positive relationship between the two leaders.
